summary.strategy: M5 breakout beyond prior 12 M5 candles; only aligned, fully closed M15 EMA20/50 trend; M5 retest confirmation; next-M5-open entry

productionManagementSimulation.weighting: Two equal-sized entries close at +1.5R; the third closes at +3R or stop. Weighted basket R is +2R at TP2 and +0.667R if the runner stops after TP1.

comparisonModel.note: Same single 2R target and one-hour horizon as the M1 research candidate for entry comparison. A separate outcome stream simulates the approved three-entry TP1 1.5R / TP2 3R management.

productionCompatibility.productionTargetManagement: TP1 1.5R on first two entries; TP2 3R on third entry

summary.note: No Telegram alerts, no production signal routing, and no MT5 execution. M15 direction must be confirmed by the last fully closed M15 candle; incomplete M15 candles are excluded.
